meta.description: Platform to create and manage evaluations for projects, courses, awards and hackathons.

assistant.title: Space assistant
assistant.intro: Ask it to prepare the evaluation and rubric, create the groups or build the schedule. If something is missing, it will ask you.
assistant.notConfigured: NVIDIA_API_KEY isn't configured on the server yet. The interface is ready.

assistant.example3: Build next Thursday's schedule at 9:00 in rooms 1.1 and 1.2, 12-minute slots.

welcome.title: Welcome to your space
welcome.intro: With these three steps you can start evaluating. The rest (schedule, recordings, audience vote) is optional.
welcome.rubricText: The criteria, their weight and what each level means.
welcome.unitsText: Import them from a list or create them one by one.
welcome.peopleText: Share the link and code, or create personal invitations.
welcome.assistantHint: Would you rather the AI set it up? Tell the <link>assistant</link>.

scene.question: How much does the kit cost?

welcome.title: Welcome to {space}
welcome.text: In a couple of minutes we'll show you how to run an evaluation from start to finish. You can skip it and watch it again anytime from your menu.

rubric.title: First, the rubric
rubric.text: Set what's evaluated, how much each criterion weighs and what each level means. In a hurry? The AI assistant suggests a complete one.

people.title: Add {units} and invite
people.text: Import the PoliformaT list or create them by hand, and share the code so the {evaluator} and students can join on their own.

live.title: Live evaluation
live.text: Everyone scores from their phone or laptop and you see progress instantly: who's missing, who hasn't started and where there's disagreement.

ai.title: The AI listens for you
ai.text: Record the presentations: they're transcribed and summarised, and the {evaluator} gets questions and weak points. Audio is never kept.

done.title: All set!
done.text: Start with the three-step guide on Home. If you get lost, the menu on the left groups everything by section.

welcome.title: Welcome to {space}
welcome.text: You'll be evaluating {units}. Here's how in half a minute.

groups.title: Your {units}
groups.text: Under “{units}” you'll find everyone assigned to you, with their members, deliverables and your private or shared notes.

score.title: Scoring is one tap
score.text: Pick a level for each criterion, add a comment if you like and send. It saves as you go, even offline.

ai.title: AI support
ai.text: If the presentation is recorded, you'll see quotes per criterion, weak points and suggested questions. It never tells you what grade to give.

done.title: Time to evaluate!
done.text: During the presentations, “Room” puts it all on one screen: the slot, the timer, the rubric and your notes.

welcome.title: Welcome to {space}
welcome.text: Everything about your group is in one place. Here's a quick tour.

deliverables.title: Your deliverables, as links
deliverables.text: Add the repository, website, video or slides from “My group”. No file uploads needed.

rubric.title: Know how you're evaluated
rubric.text: Check the rubric: the criteria, how much each one weighs and what's expected at each level.

agenda.title: Your slot, to the minute
agenda.text: The schedule tells you when you present and warns you of delays, live.

done.title: Good luck!
done.text: When results are published, you'll see your grade and comments in “My group”.

welcome.title: Welcome to {space}
welcome.text: You have view access. Here's where everything is.

groups.title: All the {units}
groups.text: Browse each one with its members and deliverables.

agenda.title: Live schedule
agenda.text: See who's presenting now and who's next.

done.title: Done!
done.text: You can watch this tutorial again anytime from your menu.
